title: Unresponsive and breathing

source.document: First Aid for Someone Unresponsive and Breathing

calming_line: Stay with them and keep checking their breathing.

emergency_call.instruction: Call emergency services and get an AED if available.

steps.instruction_template: Check the scene for safety, then check responsiveness and breathing for no more than 10 seconds.
If they are unresponsive but breathing normally, place them in the recovery position.
steps.condition: Use when the person is unresponsive and breathing normally.

steps.instruction_template: If you suspect a head, neck, or back injury, leave them as found unless you must move them for safety, CPR, or life-threatening bleeding.
steps.condition: Use when head, neck, or back injury is possible.

steps.instruction_template: Keep checking their breathing and responsiveness until help arrives.
Keep them from getting too cold or too hot. If they are cold, cover them with {cover}.

do_not_say: Do not advise giving food or drink to an unresponsive person.
Do not tell the user to leave the person alone.
Do not move a suspected spine injury unless needed for safety, CPR, or life-threatening bleeding.
